subject.title: [Feature]: Multi-role support in Chat UI for multi-agent workflows

question: Should OpenClaw add a durable per-message sender identity contract for multi-agent conversations, and which identity fields are canonical across protocol, storage, events, and UI?
rationale: The source shows several partial label/provenance paths, but choosing the permanent sender identity API and storage/UI contract is product and protocol ownership work rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Design one additive sender contract
options.body: Add a canonical sender identity payload and migrate the related narrow fixes to use it across gateway, storage, events, and UI rendering.

options.title: Keep narrow sender-label repairs only
options.body: Continue landing scoped fixes like sessions_send prompt context or WebChat fallback labels without committing to a broader protocol contract yet.

options.title: Defer multi-agent UI attribution
options.body: Leave this canonical tracker open but avoid core API work until the multi-agent Chat UI direction is more settled.

recommendation.title: Design one additive sender contract
recommendation.body: Add a canonical sender identity payload and migrate the related narrow fixes to use it across gateway, storage, events, and UI rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Gateway/session contracts and prior provenance work where steipete has the strongest history signal in the inspected commits.
